title: Turning on Deactivate parts adds a checkbox column at the left edge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have at least one active part at the test location.
  • Make sure every column is switched on in the columns button.
  • Use a desktop browser window about 1280 pixels wide, so the Inventory table scrolls sideways.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Drag the table's sideways scrollbar all the way to the right.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Deactivate parts.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The table shows its right-most columns, and the Description column is out of view.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The table scrolls back to its left edge on its own, and a new narrow column with a checkbox on every row, and one in the header, is the first column, in view.
  • Side by side with design board 4.2 at 100% zoom, the checkbox column is as narrow as the one drawn there (the PRD sets it at 44 pixels).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R4: “Turning the mode on adds a checkbox column, 44px wide, at the left of the table, and scrolls the table back to its left edge so the column is in view.”
